what_this_tests: whether the AI strategist's #1 ranked NIFTY trade earns a net return, against baselines on the same sessions, going forward. The multi-agent research runs once a day (the Complete analysis, or the 8:30 morning view) and every run that day reuses it; one LLM call then ranks exactly 8 of the app's priced candidates from the live data, strongest first. Version 4 changes who sets the direction: the app reads today's tape (price vs VWAP, EMA 9 vs EMA 21, price vs today's open, from 5-minute bars); when all three agree ('up' or 'down') only candidates in that direction are offered, when they do not ('mixed') both are. The prompt now treats the agents' research as a multi-week view for news and event risk, not as a reason by itself to bet against today's tape

version.prompt_covers: the ranking system prompt, answer schema, strategy menu, the number ranked (8), the tape-to-direction table (TAPE_ALLOWS), and the source of ask_rank_llm, ai_ranked, candidates_for_ai, today_moves, agents_view, today_research, build_context, rank, _structures, _index_levels, trade_levels, price, check_structure, morning.ai_view, strategist.today_tape, signals.today_tape and signals.intraday_frame
version.model_limit: a provider can change a deployment behind the same name; that cannot be detected here: UNVERIFIED
version.research_limit: the multi-agent research's own prompts and tools (tradingagents/) and the news it fetches are not in the hash: UNVERIFIED
version.rule: changing the prompt, the candidate code or the model starts a new test and a new count
version.tape_limit: the 5-minute bars come from the app's candle source (Yahoo when Dhan is off, which can be delayed); the tape is read from them as served, and their delay is not measured: UNVERIFIED

forward_test.frequency: the #1 of the first answer in a session counts, Complete or Quick analysis alike: 09:30 to 15:00 IST, weekdays. Trades ranked 2 to 8 do not count. A Muhurat session is not a counted session (the user does not trade it; its data is still stored)
forward_test.starts: the first weekday session after this file is on main. The user asks on the Plan tab; nothing runs by itself, so the collection freeze is unaffected
forward_test.registry: reports/ai_test/v4/registry.jsonl, append-only and hash-chained (tradingagents/research/registry.py). Version 3's, 2's and 1.1's registries are separate and unchanged
forward_test.entry: after the row is written, a fresh chain is fetched and the entry is its bid and ask (buy at the ask, sell at the bid). The registered max risk is indicative; the result uses the max risk at this entry. A leg with no two-sided quote makes the trade void, and a void trade is reported
forward_test.entry_limit: a paper entry at quoted prices, not a real fill: real slippage is not measured

other_outcomes.no_trade: the AI ranks no candidate: recorded, not a trade
other_outcomes.missed: a weekday with no question is recorded as missed and cannot be filled; holidays are corrected against NSE's sessions at settlement

forward_test.exit_rule: hold to expiry. Each leg settles at intrinsic value on NSE's final settlement price (the index close on expiry day, from the nightly store). The AI's target and stop are not used, because following them needs live monitoring and intraday prices that do not exist
forward_test.result: net P&L after charges as a percentage of max risk, per trade. Charges from the repo's model, in and out, per leg: cost model unverified

baselines.random_direction: the same structure on the same session priced from the saved entry chain: bullish or bearish at random at the same strike distances. An iron condor's centre moves up or down by 1% of spot at random, keeping its wings. 1,000 draws per trade, seeded from this file's hash
baselines.rule_based_pick: the rule-based ranking's first candidate from the same entry chain, written in the same registry row; same exit rule

forward_test.warning_at_minimum: 50 settled trades are too few to prove an edge. Below 50 nothing is reported
forward_test.pass: at exactly the verdict count, once, which is only reachable if the user extends the test: mean net % of max risk above 0, with the 2.5th percentile bound of a bootstrap by expiry week above 0, above the 97.5th percentile of the random-direction draws' means, and above the rule-based pick's mean
forward_test.otherwise: fail. No extension and no second look at the same version
forward_test.ui_until_verdict: no UNTESTED label and no typed word: the user removed both on 2026-11-04, before any trade counted under this version. Results stay 'cost model unverified'
forward_test.no_performance_before_the_stop: no performance figure is read before the stop date. This replaces version 1's reporting between 50 and 500

power.method: as gate v2: planted edge on resampled returns. NIFTY weekly options 2019-2022, three structures in a random direction, hold to expiry, net of charges, resampled by expiry week. No LLM. Closing prices stand in for bid and ask; a real mix of structures is unknown
power.edge_means: extra net return per trade as a share of max risk: 0.10 is 10% of max risk per trade
power.why_500: about 85% power at an edge of 20% of max risk. Smaller edges are not reliably detected: 55% at 15%, 19% at 10%. At one trade a session, at most about 2 years
power.applies_because: one trade a session is counted, as in version 1.1, so the same power table applies; the mix of structures is still unknown

does_not_count.reports/trade_record/trades.json: app trades (yours and the AI track record): not registered before entry
does_not_count.paper_ledger.sqlite: 1 paper position of a different, rule-based strategy: not registered before entry
does_not_count.ai_strategist_test_v1_1.json: 1 trade registered under it (2026-11-04, bull call spread), in reports/ai_test/registry.jsonl: a different test, never pooled
does_not_count.ai_strategist_test_v2.json: 2 trades counted under it (2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06, bull call spreads), in reports/ai_test/v2/registry.jsonl: a different test, never pooled
does_not_count.ai_strategist_test_v3.json: 2 trades counted under it (2026-11-09 and 2026-11-11, bear call spreads), and 2026-11-10 recorded as missed, in reports/ai_test/v3/registry.jsonl: a different test, never pooled

evaluator: scripts/ai_test_settle.py reads version 4's registry by default (webapp.ai_test.REGISTRY); versions 3, 2 and 1.1 are closed and never settled

supersedes.closed: 2026-11-11 by the user, after the AI ranked bearish trades #1 through a strong up day: on 2026-11-11 BANKNIFTY rose 2.3% and all 10 runs' #1 was bearish, following the research agents' multi-week 'Underweight' rating; in 33 saved runs the #1's direction matched the rating in 30. Its 2 counted trades stay on file and are not settled or reported

user_decision: 2026-11-11: the user asked for the cause of the losses to be fixed and agreed that the direction should come from today's market, accepting that this closes version 3 and starts a new test and a new count. The stop date, interim check, pass rule, baselines and power table carry over from version 3 unchanged. The index target and stop (set from the move to expiry) are unchanged: the user put the stop-loss question aside for later

stop.measured_on: trades registered on or before the stop date, once their expiries have settled; lower bound as in the pass rule: 2.5th percentile of a bootstrap by expiry week
stop.if_lower_bound_is_below_0: retire the test and say: no large edge detected
stop.if_above_0_and_under_500_trades: the user decides in writing to extend or retire, with the trial list shown

gaps_the_decision_did_not_name.fewer_than_50_settled_trades: no bound is computed and nothing is reported; the user decides in writing to extend or retire, with the trial list shown
gaps_the_decision_did_not_name.500_or_more_by_the_stop: cannot happen at one question a session: at most about 260 by this date

interim_check.action: none: no performance figure and no performance action

what_the_stop_means.power_at_about_260_trades: about 48% at an edge of 20% of max risk and 92% at 30%, using the table's value at 200 trades; lower at fewer
what_the_stop_means.so: the stop detects only very large edges
